office: the Australian Passport Office (Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade)
note: The fees from 1 January 2026, as the Department's notice gives them, indexed each year by the Australian Passports (Application Fees) Determination 2015; priority processing ($308, for eligible customers) is added to the passport's fee, and the overseas totals are the notice's (the surcharge is $189 for an adult or senior, $92 for a child, 16 and 17 included). The fast-track fee ($100 in 2024, indexed since) isn't in the 2026 notice, so it's null here. The determination sets no standard processing time. passports.gov.au closes the connection on this client.

sources.title: Australian High Commission, Port Moresby (Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade), Passport fees From 1 January 2026
sources.said: Passport fees From 1 January 2026 ... 10-year passport (for persons 18 and over) $422.00 $611.00 ... 10-year passport (for persons 16 or 17) $422.00 $514.00 ... 5-year passport (for children under 16) $213.00 $305.00 ... 5-year passport (optional for persons 75 and over) $213.00 $402.00 ... Priority Processing $308.00 ... Adult and Senior $189.00 $189.00 ... Child $92.00 $92.00 ... Fees are subject to annual indexation. No GST is payable on passport fees.

sources.title: Federal Register of Legislation, Australian Passports (Application Fees) Determination 2015, Compilation No. 5 (compilation date 26 November 2024; Authorised Version F2024C01230), ss. 5 to 7
sources.said: 5 Application fees ... (1) ... the fee in respect of an application of a kind mentioned in column 1 of an item ... is: (a) for an application made in the calendar year starting on 1 January 2024—the amount mentioned in column 2 of the item; or (b) for an application made in a later calendar year: (i) if the indexation factor for the calendar year is less than 1—the fee for an application of that kind for the previous calendar year; or (ii) otherwise—the amount worked out by multiplying the indexation factor for the calendar year by the amount of the fee for an application of that kind for the previous calendar year ... 1 Application for an Australian passport that is valid for up to 10 years ... $398 2 Application for an Australian passport for a child that is valid for up to 5 years ... $201 3 Application for an Australian passport: (a) for a child who is 16 or 17; and (b) that is valid for up to 10 years ... $398 4 Application by a person who is 75 or over for an Australian passport that is valid for up to 5 years ... $201 ... (4) Amounts worked out under this section must be rounded to the nearest whole dollar (rounding 50 cents upwards) ... 6 Additional fees ... 1 Application for a priority processed travel document to be issued within 2 business days ... $290 2 Application for a fast tracked travel document to be issued within 5 business days ... $100 ... 4 Application for an Australian passport ... that is made overseas (a) for an adult—$178; and (b) for a child—$87 ... 7 Indexation factor (1) ... index number, in relation to a quarter, means the All Groups Consumer Price Index number, being the weighted average of the 8 capital cities, published by the Australian Statistician in respect of that quarter. index number for most recent September year means the sum of the index numbers for the 4 quarters in the year ending 30 September in the previous calendar year. index number for past September year means the sum of the index numbers for the 4 quarters in the year ending 30 September in the year before the previous calendar year. (2) The indexation factor for a calendar year is to be worked out to 3 decimal places (rounding up if the fourth decimal place is 5 or more). (3) In working out the indexation factor: (a) use only the index numbers published in terms of the most recently published index reference period for the All Groups Consumer Price Index
